RagShortTexts: Greentower Pony has poor performance, short battery life and poor physical strength.

Variants.Content: The Greentower Pony is the finest horse of the Battanians. But it's very bad, it's just the shortcomings of hundreds of schools of thought. It has a short endurance, poor stamina, eats a lot, has little strength, its legs are slow in sprinting, and its body is generally heavy, but this is the only horse that can handle it in this cold forest.
